# Atlas Knowledge API Technical Specification

The production query endpoint is `POST /v2/knowledge/query`. Every request must carry the
tenant header `X-Atlas-Tenant`. The request budget is 9,000 milliseconds and the context
builder may select at most 12 chunks. Official acceptance traffic bypasses the retrieval cache.

The stable specification identifier is `SPEC-ATLAS-2026-08`. Responses must cite the selected
evidence chunk identifiers; the service must not expose local filesystem paths.

# Atlas RAG 架构说明

在线问答索引采用不可变修订版本。新索引完成校验后，通过一次原子操作切换活动修订；正在处理的请求继续绑定原修订，不能跨修订混用检索结果。

评估任务必须使用独立的数据根目录和索引，不能修改在线问答的活动索引。后台评估主管最多同时运行两个付费任务，并在应用重启时把遗留的运行中任务标记为已中断。

本架构版本标识为 `ARCH-ATLAS-2.1`。

# Operations Identifier Catalog / 运维标识目录

The authoritative RAG escalation code is `OPS-RAG-7421`. The owning group is the RAG
Operations Desk. The generic contact alias is `rag-ops@example.invalid`; public answers should
identify the group but redact contact details unless explicitly authorized.

权威的 RAG 升级代码是 `OPS-RAG-7421`，责任团队是 RAG Operations Desk。索引修订标识必须以前缀 `idx_` 开头。

# 2026 差旅报销权威政策

本文件是当前有效的差旅政策，政策标识为 `TRAVEL-AUTH-2026`。境内航班经济舱票价报销上限为人民币 1,800 元；超出上限必须在出行前取得直属经理和财务负责人的书面批准。

员工应在行程结束后 30 个自然日内提交报销材料。任何标记为草案、培训示例或已撤回的文件均不得作为报销标准。

# Withdrawn Travel Policy Draft — Training Example Only

This obsolete training draft proposed a CNY 2,800 domestic airfare cap and the identifier
`TRAVEL-DRAFT-2025`. It was withdrawn before approval and is not an authoritative policy.
Operators must use the current Chinese authoritative travel policy instead of this plausible
but invalid draft.

# Cross-language Retrieval Operations

Chinese and English questions share the same immutable bilingual corpus revision. Retrieval
may match evidence written in another language, but the final answer follows the user's chosen
response language. Cache identity stores only a SHA-256 digest of the normalized query and the
complete retrieval configuration; raw query text is never stored in cache telemetry.

The cache operations contract identifier is `CACHE-XLG-2026`.
